run_check_valid_test_overlaps: run the script to check for overlaps between training and test multilingual sentence data
run_get_all_test_data: run get_all_test_data to load test sentences across language directions into a lookup dictionary
run_check_train_sentences: run check_train_sentences to find training sentences that overlap with test data for a direction
run_check_train_all: run check_train_all to check all training directions for sentence overlap with test data
run_load_sentences: run load_sentences to read source and target sentence files for a given split and direction
